content:
I noticed that the Bayes and minimax APIs are a bit asymmetrical. I plan to create a PR which just adds the minimax analogs of the three data-processing inequalities for the Bayes risk in Mathlib.Probability.Decision.Risk.Basic. @Rémy Degenne, would this be welcome?

This is partly to contribute and partly to familiarize myself with the process as a first-time contributor.
